name: Break-the-Fast Buttermilk Waffles
notes: To substitute regular milk for buttermilk, add about 1 Tbsp lemon juice to 1½ cups milk and let curdle before mixing with dry ingredients.

steps.title: Whip the egg whites
steps.body: Separate, and whip the whites to soft peaks: **3 eggs**.

steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.body: In another mixing bowl, combine: **1¾ cups flour** (may use whole wheat), **2 tsp baking powder**, **1 tsp baking soda** and **½ tsp salt**.

steps.title: Mix the wet ingredients
steps.body: Add and mix together: **1½ cups buttermilk**, **½ cup melted shortening** and **3 egg yolks**.

steps.title: Fold and cook
steps.body: Fold in beaten egg whites, and cook on waffle iron.

steps.title: Top and serve
steps.body: Top with syrups, sausage, nuts, berries, cut fruit, and yogurt.
